newsitem.title: USA: Cominco's Anvil deal clouds concs picture.
newsitem.headline: Cominco's Anvil deal clouds concs picture.

text.p: Cominco Limited's move to snap up C$9.4 million worth of shares in Anvil Range Mining has muddied the zinc and lead concentrates picture just at a time when miners and smelters are locked in talks over this year's deals, industry sources said.
"I think the picture is kind of cloudy because of activity at Anvil Range," a North American zinc concentrates seller said.
Another company, Mineral Resources Corp said on January 17 it intended to make a takeover bid for Anvil Range.
